label: Slant Welt
description: Welt lower pockets cut on a diagonal slant, angling up toward the sides like hacking pockets. The slanted welts add movement and a sporting, equestrian character while remaining single-strip welts. They give the waistcoat a dynamic, country-tailoring edge.
